tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Est.2.15;
father of: Esther (H0635)
§ Abihail = "my father is might"
1) a Levite in Moses's time
2) a Gadite
3) father of Esther
4) wife of Abishur
5) wife of Rehoboam

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
strongs_1890.derivation: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from H1 (אָב) and H2428 (חַיִל); father (i.e. possessor) of might;
